summary: Accept fractal recorder schemas and marker files while preserving legacy writers and legacy-first marker selection.

replay.detail: No replay or historical data rewrite.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination change.

compatibility.detail: Recorder marker, command and receipt schemas accept fractal alongside st3, and readers recognize fractal-recorder.json. When both marker files exist, st3-recorder.json wins even when malformed. Writers, hash domains and signatures are unchanged.

manual.detail: No manual steps; stored legacy data remains supported.

recovery.detail: Legacy writers remain unchanged; rollback requires no data migration.
